name: hallucination-invalid-questions-mysql-explanation-benchmarking
description: A benchmark that evaluates language models' tendency to hallucinate when asked invalid or nonsensical questions about MySQL, measuring whether models produce incorrect factual answers or properly abstain. It pairs invalid/ill-posed SQL-related queries with expected behavior (e.g., refusal, clarification request, or no-answer) and collects model explanations for why the question is invalid. The dataset is intended to assess both answer correctness and the quality of model explanations in database/SQL scenarios.
reputation: A niche Hugging Face dataset focused on model hallucination in SQL contexts; modest adoption within robustness/QA evaluation communities.
